connectorTemplate.name: Facebook Pages
connectorTemplate.description: Connect to Facebook Pages API to manage page posts, comments, and engagement. Publish text posts, read page feed, update

page_id.description: Default Facebook Page ID to use for API calls

actions.name: list-my-pages
actions.description: Retrieves a list of Facebook Pages that the authenticated user can manage. Returns page details including ID, name, access token, category, and tasks the user can perform on each page.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve (e.g., 'id,name,access_token,category,category_list,tasks,fan_count,about')

actions.name: publish-post
actions.description: Publishes a text post to a Facebook Page's feed. Returns the created post ID and optionally specified fields. Requires pages_manage_posts permission.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return from the created post (e.g., 'id,created_time,message,from,permalink_url')

message.description: The text content of the post to publish

page_id.description: The ID of the Facebook Page to publish to

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: get-page-feed
actions.description: Retrieves posts from a Facebook Page's feed. Returns a list of posts published on or to the page, including visitor posts. Supports pagination and field selection.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (1-100)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve for each post (e.g., 'id,message,created_time,from,permalink_url,story,type,status_type')

page_id.description: The ID of the Facebook Page

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: get-published-posts
actions.description: Retrieves only published posts from a Facebook Page. Returns approximately 600 ranked published posts per year. Excludes unpublished posts and visitor posts.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (1-100)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve (e.g., 'id,message,created_time,permalink_url,is_published,status_type,type')

page_id.description: The ID of the Facebook Page

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: get-post
actions.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Facebook post by ID. Returns post content, metadata, engagement metrics, and other specified fields.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve (e.g., 'id,message,created_time,from,permalink_url,status_type,type,is_published,shares,reactions.summary(true)')

post_id.description: The ID of the post to retrieve (format: {page_id}_{post_id})

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: update-post
actions.description: Updates an existing Facebook post's message content. Only the app that created the post can update it. Returns success status upon completion.

message.description: The new text content for the post

post_id.description: The ID of the post to update (format: {page_id}_{post_id})

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: delete-post
actions.description: Permanently deletes a Facebook post. This action is irreversible. Returns success status. Warning: Always verify the post ID before deletion to avoid accidental data loss.

post_id.description: The ID of the post to delete (format: {page_id}_{post_id})

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: get-post-comments
actions.description: Retrieves comments on a Facebook post. Returns a list of comments with author information, message text, creation time, and engagement metrics. Supports pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return (1-100)

order.description: Order of comments: 'chronological' (oldest first) or 'reverse_chronological' (newest first)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve for each comment (e.g., 'id,message,created_time,from,like_count,comment_count,parent')

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: reply-to-comment
actions.description: Replies to a comment on a Facebook post. Creates a nested comment as a reply. Returns the created comment ID. Requires pages_manage_engagement permission.

message.description: The text content of the reply

comment_id.description: The ID of the comment to reply to

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: get-comment
actions.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific comment by ID. Returns comment content, author information, timestamps, and engagement metrics.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve (e.g., 'id,message,created_time,from,like_count,comment_count,parent,attachment,can_comment,can_remove')

comment_id.description: The ID of the comment to retrieve

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: update-comment
actions.description: Updates the message text of an existing comment. Can also be used to hide/unhide comments on Page posts. Returns success status.

message.description: The new text content for the comment (optional if only hiding/unhiding)

is_hidden.description: Set to true to hide the comment, false to unhide it (only applicable to Page comments)

comment_id.description: The ID of the comment to update

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: delete-comment
actions.description: Permanently deletes a comment. Page admins can delete any comment on their Page's posts. Returns success status. Warning: This action is irreversible.

comment_id.description: The ID of the comment to delete

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: get-page-info
actions.description: Retrieves detailed information about a Facebook Page including name, category, about section, fan count, and other metadata.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve (e.g., 'id,name,category,about,fan_count,website,phone,emails,cover,picture,link')

page_id.description: The ID of the Facebook Page

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: search-pages
actions.description: Searches for Facebook Pages by keyword or name. Returns a list of pages matching the query with basic information. Useful for finding pages to mention or tag.

q.description: Search query or keyword to find pages (e.g., 'coffee shop', 'technology')

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve (e.g., 'id,name,category,location,link,verification_status')

actions.name: get-page-insights
actions.description: Retrieves analytics and insights for a Facebook Page including impressions, reach, engagement, and other metrics. Supports various metrics and date ranges.

since.description: Start date in Unix timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD format

until.description: End date in Unix timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD format

metric.description: Array of metric names to retrieve (e.g., ['page_impressions', 'page_engaged_users', 'page_post_engagements', 'page_fans'])

page_id.description: The ID of the Facebook Page

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: get-post-insights
actions.description: Retrieves analytics and insights for a specific post including impressions, reach, engagement, reactions, and other performance metrics.

metric.description: Array of metric names to retrieve (e.g., ['post_impressions', 'post_engaged_users', 'post_clicks', 'post_reactions_by_type_total'])

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: get-post-reactions
actions.description: Retrieves reactions (like, love, wow, haha, sad, angry) on a Facebook post. Returns a list of users who reacted and their reaction type.

limit.description: Maximum number of reactions to return (1-100)

summary.description: Include summary with total reaction counts by type

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: get-page-posts
actions.description: Retrieves posts published by the Page only (excludes visitor posts). Returns posts created by the Page with customizable fields and pagination support.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (1-100)

since.description: Lower bound of the time range to retrieve posts (Unix timestamp or strtotime data value)

until.description: Upper bound of the time range to retrieve posts (Unix timestamp or strtotime data value)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve (e.g., 'id,message,created_time,permalink_url,type,status_type,shares,reactions.summary(true)')

page_id.description: The ID of the Facebook Page

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: schedule-post
actions.description: Schedules a text post to be published to a Facebook Page at a future date and time. The scheduled time must be between 10 minutes and 75 days from now. Returns the post ID.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return

message.description: The text content of the post

page_id.description: The ID of the Facebook Page to publish to

published.description: Must be set to false for scheduled posts

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

scheduled_publish_time.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when to publish the post. Must be between 10 minutes and 75 days from now.

actions.name: get-scheduled-posts
actions.description: Retrieves all scheduled posts for a Facebook Page that have not yet been published. Returns scheduled post details including scheduled publish time and message content.

limit.description: Maximum number of scheduled posts to return (1-100)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve (e.g., 'id,message,scheduled_publish_time,is_published,created_time,from')

page_id.description: The ID of the Facebook Page

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: get-page-conversations
actions.description: Retrieves conversations (message threads) for a Facebook Page. Returns a list of conversations with participants and message previews. Requires pages_messaging permission.

limit.description: Maximum number of conversations to return (1-100)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve (e.g., 'id,participants,updated_time,message_count,unread_count,snippet')

page_id.description: The ID of the Facebook Page

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: get-conversation-messages
actions.description: Retrieves messages from a specific conversation thread. Returns individual messages with sender information, content, and timestamps. Requires pages_messaging permission.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (1-100)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve (e.g., 'id,message,from,created_time,to,attachments')

conversation_id.description: The ID of the conversation thread

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: send-message
actions.description: Sends a text message in a Page conversation. The Page can only send messages within 24 hours of the person's last message, or using message tags. Requires pages_messaging permission.

conversation_id.description: The ID of the conversation thread

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.

actions.name: get-current-user
actions.description: Retrieves information about the currently authenticated Facebook user. Returns user ID, name, and other profile information based on granted permissions.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve (e.g., 'id,name,email,picture,link')

actions.name: get-visitor-posts
actions.description: Retrieves posts published by visitors (other users) on the Page's timeline. Returns posts that were created by people other than the Page itself.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (1-100)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve (e.g., 'id,message,created_time,from,permalink_url,type,story')

page_id.description: The ID of the Facebook Page

page_access_token.description: Optional Page Access Token for this specific page. If not provided, uses the connector's default User Access Token.
